zoom.description: The canvas scale, written by the component and bound two ways to the view's zoom property.

targetDomId.description: The DOM id of the scrolling canvas the gestures act on (a Perspective component's domId).

guardBrowserZoom.description: Prevent the same gestures anywhere else on the document, so the browser never zooms the frame; on touch devices the viewport meta gains maximum-scale=1.

viewWidth.description: The target's measured width in px, written by the component when it changes (0 until measured); the page's fit reads it, so a docked faceplate or a reload needs no session flag.

viewHeight.description: The target's measured height in px, written by the component when it changes (0 until measured).
